findings.observation: The owned-action success path is revisioned, owner-gated, idempotent on the backend, and returns a canonical receipt, but its iOS recovery state is materially weaker than Proposal review. The outcome draft and completion receipt live only in PursuitDetailView state; PursuitWorkspaceStore creates a fresh operation UUID at submission and does not persist it; PursuitWorkspaceServing exposes no operation readback. If the app is interrupted before submission, the observed-outcome draft is lost. If the backend commits and the response is lost, relaunch can reload the completed action but cannot reconcile and display the exact submitted operation receipt or distinguish that response-loss case from a later canonical change. The frozen response-loss journey covers Proposal review, not action completion.

Dimension calibration: Trigger relevance 3; Capture burden 3; Evidence review 3; State integrity 3; Action usefulness 3; Write safety 2; Interruption recovery 2; Wedge discipline 3.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter recording a just-observed client outcome can have to reconstruct the note after interruption or see the canonical completion without the operation receipt that proves which submission applied. The backend prevents a duplicate mutation, but the user-facing recovery loop does not yet remove uncertainty or reconciliation work.
findings.recommendation: Give action completion the same durable operation lifecycle as Proposal review: persist the trimmed draft and stable operation ID before POST, show an outcome-unknown locked state after ambiguous failure, reconcile that exact operation after relaunch, and restore either the canonical receipt or a truthful retry state without generating a second operation.
findings.verification: Use a response-loss proxy that commits action completion and drops the response, then terminate and relaunch the app. The recruiter must see no success before reconciliation; relaunch must restore the exact action, outcome text, operation ID, revision transition, and receipt; the proxy and backend must show one POST, one operation, one revision increment, and zero external effects. Repeat with interruption before POST and with a genuinely failed POST to prove draft restoration and safe retry.

findings.criterion: Trigger relevance and high-load scan cost
findings.observation: Today now preserves every attention-bearing Pursuit, correctly prioritizes a due owned action, and keeps outcome, target, blocker, evidence freshness, owner, due work, state, and Proposal access together. In the frozen many-search screenshot, however, 10 Pursuits deserve judgment and each item renders the full decision brief plus one or two actions in a single undifferentiated scroll. The implementation removes the dangerous display cap but provides no compact index, grouping, or progressive disclosure for that high-load state.

findings.user_impact: An independent recruiter will not lose work to an arbitrary cap, but at realistic multi-search load the first working surface can become a long reading queue. That raises scan and scroll time when the immediate job is to find the few decisions that will decay first.
findings.recommendation: Keep every attention-bearing Pursuit available and keep due-action ordering, but add a compact progressive-disclosure mode or priority index that exposes pursuit, why now, owner, due state, and evidence freshness before expanding the full context. Do not replace the list with candidate scores, hidden ranking, or a smaller capped subset.
findings.verification: Seed at least 10 active Pursuits spanning overdue owned actions, fresh and stale Proposals, unavailable evidence, open gaps, and no-action state. In a timed interrupted-use test, recruiters must locate and explain the three most time-sensitive decisions without an omission, while every attention-bearing Pursuit remains reachable and traceable to canonical context.

findings.observation: The frozen executable flow is now smaller than the earlier clerical pattern: Text Signal requires exact words, explicit Person/Pursuit scope and attribution, offers evidence-only sync, and uses a human-readable optional milestone without asking the recruiter to type an enum or restate a rationale. The artifact nevertheless contains no design-partner comparison showing that capture, review, and observed-outcome recording are faster or less error-prone than the recruiter's existing note, chat, calendar, or CRM fallback.

findings.user_impact: The local workflow is credible and safe, but without field comparison it is unknown whether repeated capture and review earn their interruption cost or whether recruiters fall back to memory and manual CRM entry. A synthetic successful action cannot establish recurring usefulness.
findings.recommendation: Run a design-partner crossover study using authorized synthetic or purpose-approved material: compare the current flow with each recruiter's actual fallback and measure time to verified state, repeated typing, corrections, abandoned captures, manual reconciliation, action completion, and stale-action rate. Keep claims limited to local deterministic behavior until this evidence exists.
findings.verification: Across representative clear, ambiguous, same-name, no-action, stale, deletion, interruption, and response-loss cases, report per-case median time, correction rate, completion rate, fallback rate, and trust-breaking errors. Promote a workflow-value claim only if the predefined thresholds beat the manual path without increasing identity, evidence, or write mistakes.

strengths: The Today projection now preserves one consolidated card for every attention-bearing Pursuit without a display cap; a due owned action wins primary priority while the same Pursuit's Proposal and evidence-backed gap remain visible in context.

The canonical action path is specific, timely, and owned: the recruiter records an observed outcome, receives revisioned readback and a structured receipt, and the visible action state explicitly confirms that no message, calendar event, or external write occurred.

Text Signal separates local save from explicit sync, provides an evidence-only outcome, replaces machine-token entry with human milestone choices, and keeps same-name People distinct through visible Pursuit/context clues and stable Person, role, and relationship-context readback.

Proposal review keeps exact evidence, identity, epistemic state, before/proposed values, reason, effect, item-level confirm/edit/reject/unresolved choices, stale conflicts, duplicate protection, response-loss reconciliation, and canonical receipt binding coherent.

Source deletion degrades current authority without silently rewriting the recruiter-confirmed historical value, and the UI exposes the unavailable authority, confirmer, decision time, Proposal, and receipt lineage.
The workflow remains Pursuit-centered, accepts no-action, and contains no candidate-quality, fit, personality, protected-trait, or acceptance-probability scoring.
missing_evidence: Manual VoiceOver traversal by a human over the complete capture, identity, Proposal review, action completion, receipt, retry, and recovery journey remains missing.
Physical-device Action Button, microphone, foreground recording, system-capture, file-protection, and privacy behavior remain unproven; the frozen device evidence is Simulator-only.
The credentialed Claude Agent SDK evaluation has zero of five required trials because no credential or pinned model was available; deterministic provider trials do not replace live-provider evidence.

Production authentication, retention and deletion operations, regional data controls, provider reconciliation, cross-tenant adversarial testing, and production external-state behavior remain unavailable.

No design-partner recruiter study measures time saved, correction burden, repeated typing, scan cost at high active-search load, fallback rate, action completion, or recurring workflow value; no authorized candidate-side experience study is included.
No action-completion response-loss, termination/relaunch, restored-draft, or exact-operation-reconciliation test is frozen, and no cross-device or next-day return test covers changed canonical state.
Real candidate content was intentionally excluded and must remain excluded from this panel; synthetic success cannot establish real relationship outcomes.
open_questions: Will action completion adopt the same persisted operation and unknown-outcome reconciliation contract already used by Proposal review?
What compact, non-ranking presentation lets a recruiter scan 10 or more attention-bearing Pursuits without hiding any canonical work?
What predefined field thresholds for time to verified state, correction rate, fallback rate, action completion, and stale work will be required before making a recruiter-usefulness claim?
